display_name: Retail Lending - Early-Bucket Collections Contact Resolution
process_step: Collections > Early delinquency (1-30 days past due) > Customer response handling
description: A borrower in early delinquency responds to a reminder. The workflow decides the next action: book a promise to pay, stop collections, reverse a charge, or hand hardship and flagged cases to a trained officer.

promise_to_pay.label: Promise to pay
promise_to_pay.on_valid: Book promise to pay and pause outbound contact until the due date
promise_to_pay.on_invalid: Decline new promise: send payment link and continue standard cadence
promise_to_pay.policy_query: promise to pay broken promises policy days pause contact

already_paid.label: Claims already paid
already_paid.on_valid: Mark paid, stop collections contact and confirm to borrower
already_paid.on_invalid: Request payment proof and continue cadence
already_paid.policy_query: payment already made ledger reconciliation stop contact proof

charge_dispute.label: Charge dispute
charge_dispute.on_valid: Reverse the charge and correct the statement
charge_dispute.on_invalid: Explain the charge with the applicable schedule of charges
charge_dispute.policy_query: late fee penalty bounce charge schedule of charges reversal

hardship.label: Financial hardship
hardship.on_valid: Refer for restructuring assessment and pause contact
hardship.on_invalid: Offer hardship documentation checklist and pause contact 7 days
hardship.policy_query: financial hardship restructuring assessment pause contact fair practice

wrong_party.label: Wrong party contacted
wrong_party.on_valid: Remove contact number, stop outreach and log third-party contact
wrong_party.on_invalid: Verify identity through registered channel before any disclosure
wrong_party.policy_query: wrong party third party contact disclosure remove number

value_model._note: ASSUMPTIONS for illustration. Replace with the lender's measured baseline before building a business case.
